steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ summary as the required starting point.
Move to the separate vendor session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the live RFQ pricing round from the vendor portal.
Enter and submit the vendor's bid using the required two-decimal price.
Assert that the vendor portal accepted the bid and shows it as submitted.
Return to the buyer session to verify the recorded bid and calculated totals.
Open the buyer's comparison grid containing the submitted bid.
Verify that the submitted decimal rate is recorded exactly as 100.55.
Assert that the line amount and sum total use the recorded rate multiplied by the requested quantity.
